title: OL-20261122-1: core/flowbalance cannot be pushed to ultrastable/workers from code sessions
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** tenant-sync lane pass
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:FLOW-BALANCE-1
**Status:** closed

This session's GitHub integration gets 403 on writes to ultrastable/workers (git push and git refs API). The module is a copy of seed/worker/src/flowbalance.js with its test (5 pass). The seed/scripts/balance.py half of FLOW-BALANCE-1 landed.

**Disposition:** fixed. ultrastable/workers is archived; core lives in workers/ in this repository, where core/flowbalance already exists. foundation/saydo.py now resolves paths under workers/, and `saydo --probe rules:FLOW-BALANCE-1` passes.
